propositions: Truncated bridge-echo comments lack the reconciler marker because marker is appended after body, causing truncation to remove it before persistence
836 unmarked truncated comments across three issues (REB-1567, REB-1931, REB-2605) must be deduplicated by keeping oldest copy per distinct normalized body and deleting 827 truncated duplicates
The identification rule requires both presence of truncation suffix AND absence of reconciler marker; length check against rendered text is incorrect and must be removed

After bridge re-enablement, the keep-one rule must invert to preserve the comment ID recorded in the bindings store rather than the oldest copy, to avoid orphaning recorded ids and recreating the original defect
First bridge pass after cleanup will re-post approximately one copy per distinct truncated comment (not re-inflate to 836), then deduplicate from pass 2 onward
